description: Page part of ACC: /regiment and /report never print a casualty rate above 100 percent. The name sorts after PG-core, whose PGC-regiment-rate patch writes the text this anchors on.

patches.note: a computed or recorded casualty rate above 100 percent is shown as a dash with the reason in the tooltip (the 107th Pennsylvania printed 135.2 percent, the 6th US Cavalry 107.1)
same guard for the report page: no row for a rate above 100 percent
